name: asml-marketplace
description: ASML plugin marketplace for Grok Build — mocked plugins covering lithography software engineering use cases

plugins.name: asml-embedded-control
plugins.description: Real-time C++ machine-control plugin for TWINSCAN NXE/EXE scanners. Scaffold mechatronic modules, review cycle-budget code, and apply motion-safety patterns. Mock — no production machine interface.

plugins.name: asml-computational-litho
plugins.description: Computational lithography plugin for OPC, inverse lithography (ILT), and source-mask optimization (SMO). Set up mask-correction jobs and inspect mocked process-window results.

plugins.name: asml-metrology
plugins.description: On-scanner and YieldStar metrology plugin for overlay, CD, focus, and edge-placement-error (EPE) analysis. Build wafer-map reports and correction recipes from mocked metrology data.

plugins.name: asml-litho-insight
plugins.description: Holistic lithography application plugin for Litho InSight-style APC. Design lot-to-lot and wafer-to-wafer process-control loops from metrology feedback into scanner setpoints.

plugins.name: asml-fab-integration
plugins.description: Fab host-integration plugin for SECS/GEM, GEM300, and HSMS. Build recipe download, equipment-constant, and alarm flows against a mocked scanner host.

plugins.name: asml-test-diagnostics
plugins.description: Calibration, diagnostics, and hardware-in-the-loop test plugin for ASML scanners. Author Python calibration scripts, HIL/SIL plans, and diagnostic playbooks.
